name: Gosh Is Launcher
description:
A compact launcher for GNOME Shell with interchangeable looks (Spotlight, Omarchy/Walker, Pop!_OS COSMIC, Ulauncher, KRunner, GNOME, Rofi, Raycast, Albert, Wofi, Fuzzel, Anyrun, Tofi, Light, PowerToys, Synapse, Onagre).

Features:
* Instant app search using GNOME-style matching - prefix, word-prefix, substring, GenericName, and Keywords
* Desktop-file actions and New Window for the best app match
* Apps ranked by match quality and usage frequency, filtered by parental controls
* Open window switcher with workspace labels. Type workspace 2 to switch. Type close firefox, quit firefox, or kill firefox to close or force-quit matching windows
* Recent files
* GTK folder bookmarks
* URL opener (https, sftp, smb, mailto, magnet; javascript is rejected)
* Path opener (~/ ./ and absolute paths). Directories also offer Open in Terminal
* Optional command runner (! prefix)
* Prefix modes (= calc, @ web, # settings, $ windows, . files, ! command). # . and $ need a following space so #ff0000, .bashrc, and $HOME stay normal searches
* Inline calculator (type '12 * 8 + 3', '=2^8', 'sqrt(16)', '5!', '2pi', 'log(100)', '0xff+1', '50%', or '50% of 80', press Enter to copy result to clipboard)
* Unit conversion (10 km to mi, 32 f to c, 32°f to c, 1 gb to mib)
* XDG user folders (Documents, Downloads, Pictures)
* Local time and date (type time, now, date, today, or tomorrow)
* Color copy (#f00, #ff0000, rgb(255, 0, 0), hsl(0, 100%, 50%), or hsl(0deg 100% 50%))
* System actions (lock, suspend, restart, shut down, log out, switch user, rotation lock, screenshot)
* GNOME Settings panels search including Privacy & Security subpages
* Web search fallback (Google / DuckDuckGo / Brave / Bing / Startpage / Ecosia / Qwant / Kagi / Wikipedia)
* Enable or disable every provider from preferences
* Always opens on the primary monitor, centered or top-anchored
* Click outside or press Esc to close

CLIPBOARD ACCESS: This extension writes to the clipboard ONLY when the user explicitly selects a calculator, unit-conversion, hex-color, or time/date result (presses Enter on a math expression, a conversion such as 10 km to mi, a #hex color, or time/date). No clipboard data is read or transmitted to any third party. This is a user-initiated action, not background access.

Open with Ctrl+Space (set in preferences).
